text:
anya: Heads-up — product idea: show routing/quotas mapping in the route analytics pane. Right now console lists saved queries but it's not obvious which saved view triggers fallback routing or quota enforcement. cc @mike @sophia :thinking_face:

mike: +1. We debated this in API shape. Backend needs to expose `route_bindings` for saved_views. Current saved views API only returns filters and owner. Could add `route_bindings` and `fallback_policy`. :thumbsup:

mike: example saved_view payload:

```json
{
  "id": "sv_123",
  "name": "rt-high-traffic",
  "filters": {"model": "open-20b", "status": "success"},
  "route_bindings": ["/api/v1/completions","/api/v1/chat"],
  "fallback_policy": {"type": "fallback_order", "order": ["open-7b","open-3b"] }
}
```

sophia: Telemetry + rollout UX: surface eval buckets and when fallback happened in last 7d. Add a tiny timeline + counts (e.g., "fallbacks: 324, tokens_fallbacked: 1.2M"). Also tie to rollout stage (canary/ga) so PMs know if a canary causes excessive fallback.

jordan: Also surface quota headroom per-route and per-model. When headroom <10% show amber and include quick "failover plan" dropdown (choose model variant or pause new sessions). We should also expose estimated cost delta when fallback occurs.

mike: Implementation nit: naming debate — `route_bindings` vs `scopes`. I prefer `scopes` to match telemetry naming, but `bindings` is clearer for UI. open to alternative `route_scope`.

anya: Migration concern: if we change schema, old saved_views should default to no bindings and no fallback. Need small migration script and feature flag to opt-in.

sophia: I'll post mockups later today: console will show per-route "Saved views (bound)" list and a mini-stats pill. Also will add an action "Override fallback" at route level.

mike: plan: add `?include_bindings=true` param to saved_views endpoint + emit `route:fallback` event with fields {route, saved_view_id, from_model, to_model, tokens}. Flagged behind ff-savedview-bindings. I'll open PR.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prod -> feature flags roll (ff-savedview-bindings = off) — canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

anya: :raised_hands: great. Let's sync Tues 09:30 PT to align rollout + console alerts. Thanks!
